goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): For the visible buy pad, pulse a green Highlight or neon glow and its price tag while the owner's Cash >= cost, and stop it when not affordable or after a buy. Count it in a 'highlights' census counter. When a player touches a pad with too little cash, flash the pad red, play an error buzz and show a short 'Need $N' toast without deducting cash. Hook into UpgradeService and UpgradeFx, and increment a pad_denied counter.. It has on-screen UI: use it like a player, through its buttons (`ui` + press): open its panel and press its action buttons (claim, buy, equip), and check what changed
summary: The playtester opened the Shop, bought Dropper 2, Speed 1 and Silver Ore through the panel, and pressed Rebirth twice (rebirth_denied=2). It never triggered the unaffordable-pad denial (red flash, 'Need $N' toast, pad_denied), because go_touch on the unaffordable pads failed. The 'highlights' counter reached 8, but no evidence shows the green pulse stopping or a denial happening, and 'pad_denied' never appears in the counters.

bugs.title: Unaffordable upgrade pads can't be touched, so the 'Need $N' denial path is unreachable
bugs.evidence: Step 6 (UpgradePad_dropper4, $1300 vs Cash 110) and step 8 (UpgradePad_mult2, $2200 vs Cash 440) both returned done=False 'never touched'. The playtester reported CanTouch=false on the mult2 pad. The 'pad_denied' counter is absent from the final ForgeProbe counters, so the red flash, error buzz and toast were never exercised. The denial is a core part of the feature, and it can't fire if unaffordable pads don't register touches.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button on Card_mult1 (Cash x1.5, $300) does not fire when affordable
bugs.evidence: Steps 9 and 11 clicked ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_mult1.State at 739,640 with Cash 884 and then about 1.1K, well above $300. Both reported 'button did NOT fire'. Cash was not deducted and the card stayed on 'Buy'. The other Buy buttons (dropper2, speed1, tier_silver) fired in steps 2-4. This may be a clipped, offscreen or overlapped card in the scroll list.

bugs.title: Pad affordability highlight is barely evidenced
bugs.evidence: The 'highlights' counter is 8 but 'pad_highlighted' is only 1. The trace never shows the green pulse or price-tag pulse starting or stopping at the affordability threshold or after a buy, so the feature cannot be confirmed from the session.
